# Dialmycalls

DialMyCalls provides a mass notification system enabling users to send voice and text messages to contacts.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dialmycalls/.

## Actions

- **Add Access Account**: Add a new access (sub) account.
- **Add Contact**: Add a contact to your contact list.
- **Add Group**: Add a new contact group.
- **Delete Access Account**: Delete an access (sub) account by id.
- **Delete Caller ID**: Delete a caller id.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact by id.
- **Delete Group**: Delete a contact group by id.
- **Delete Recording**: Delete a recording by id.
- **Get Access Account**: Retrieve an access (sub) account by id.
- **Get Account**: Retrieve your main account details.
- **Get Caller ID**: Retrieve a caller id by id.
- **Get Contact**: Retrieve a contact by its unique id.
- **Get Group**: Retrieve a contact group by id.
- **Get Recording**: Retrieve a recording by id.
- **List Access Accounts**: List all access (sub) accounts.
- **List Caller IDs**: List all caller ids on the account.
- **List Calls**: List all call broadcasts on the account.
- **List Contacts**: List all contacts in your contact list.
- **List Contacts in Group**: List contacts by contact group id.
- **List Do Not Contacts**: List all do not contact entries.
- **List Groups**: List all contact groups.
- **List Recordings**: List all recordings.
- **List Text Broadcasts**: List all outgoing text broadcasts.
- **List Vanity Numbers**: List all vanity numbers.
- **Update Access Account**: Update an existing access (sub) account by id.
- **Update Caller ID**: Update an existing caller id by id.
